company.name: DEKODE
company.about: DEKODE helps businesses and communities modernise their systems, adopt AI with confidence, and build digital products that teams actually want to use. We handle the complexity so you don’t have to: from strategy and architecture through to build, security, and long-term support.
company.mission: We make technology work for the people who use it.
company.origin: We started DEKODE because we kept seeing the same problem: businesses that knew they needed to evolve but couldn’t find a partner that made the process feel manageable. The big IT firms were too expensive, too impersonal, and spoke a language most teams couldn’t follow. Meanwhile, the technology gap kept growing. We believed there was a better way. Practical technology, delivered simply, at a price that respects your budget. No jargon. No bloated scopes. No disappearing after launch. That belief still drives everything we do.
company.vision: DEKODE is building toward becoming a trusted global technology partner for businesses navigating that shift. Our goal is simple: make digital transformation and AI adoption accessible, affordable, and genuinely useful for the people it’s meant to serve.
company.belief: Progress only counts when it reaches everyone.

founder.name: Pankaj Banga
founder.bio: Pankaj founded DEKODE Global after two decades as a developer, architect, and business strategist - long enough to watch expensive systems sit unused because they answered questions nobody in the business was actually asking. That's the problem DEKODE exists to solve: not more technology, but technology that works the way your business actually needs it to. Pankaj also founded the Second Innings Foundation, working with special children - a reminder that real impact doesn't stop at the office door.

We design and develop custom AI solutions, from machine learning models to generative AI features, that plug directly into your operations and deliver measurable results.

Generative AI solutions tailored to your workflows

It’s a system of recommendations, personalisation, search intelligence, and automation. We build e-commerce platforms with AI woven in from the ground up, so your customers get better experiences and your operations run leaner.

Personalised product recommendations and intelligent search

We connect your stack, build custom integrations, and automate the manual processes that slow your team down, so information flows cleanly and work gets done faster.

services.summary: Secure, scalable foundations, with someone watching the systems so you don’t have to. Everything we build runs on infrastructure that’s designed for reliability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability. We handle cloud strategy, migration, day-to-day IT management, and security hardening as one connected service. Not separate line items from separate teams.

caseStudies.name: Food Manufacturing Company
caseStudies.challenge: Followed a traditional paper-based management system that constantly led to operational and management inefficiencies resulting in depleting business profitability and sustainability.
caseStudies.solution: Designed and developed digital Production Management System that increased productivity by 20% in Phase 1.
caseStudies.outcome: By eliminating paper-based information management and moving to an Electronic Information Capturing and Production Management System, Food manufacturer reduced the manual efforts and associated costs by 20% in Phase 1 . Further, the information database will provide Food manufacturer with a rich source of information to find and test areas of operational improvement in future. The electronic system provides instant feedback which enables management to measure the impact and propose improvements along the way.
caseStudies.obstacles: The Shepparton plant relied on paper records that were difficult to store and retrieve, disconnected from corporate reporting, time-consuming to reconcile, and unable to give management reliable visibility into procurement, waste, inventory, and production performance.
caseStudies.deliveryApproach: DEKODE worked through understand, design, develop and iterate, and deploy stages: identifying loss-making operational gaps, designing a cloud-based information capture and management system with simple interfaces, a database, and reports, validating a prototype with client feedback, and deploying within the client's budget and timeframe with support.

testimonials.quote: DEKODE delivered to us a progressive and sustainable platform for strong growth ahead. They guided us step by step at every stage of the project which enabled us simplify and strategies our production, inventory and reporting process and ensured timely delivery of the expectations.
testimonials.author: Vinesh Narula

caseStudies.name: Primary School
caseStudies.challenge: Followed a manual paper-based management and administration system that constantly led them to lose a lot of useful data and gradually saw in a decline in the safety of the school.
caseStudies.solution: Provided a fully automated management software called “AttendMe”.
caseStudies.outcome: By adopting an automated system, Primary school noticed a decline in the administrative overheads and eliminated the unnecessary time and energy spent maintaining records on paper. Through their information capturing system, Primary school was also able to archive, locate and report compliance to the authorities. This helped release a lot of administrative workload. By working with DEKODE, Primary school was able to smoothen their operations, further providing a safer environment for children and helping parents release any of their worries. Primary school looks forward to working with DEKODE to maintain its data management systems.
caseStudies.obstacles: Primary school manually recorded administration data, visitors, child pickup and drop-off, staff, and incidents. Storing, locating, archiving, and reporting those records increased administrative cost and made compliance reporting inefficient.
caseStudies.deliveryApproach: DEKODE replaced paper-based administration with an automated cloud information-capture system that supports record storage, retrieval, archiving, visitor and movement records, incident management, and compliance reporting.

testimonials.quote: We engaged DEKODE to develop our check in/check out an app for our new office area which opened in 2016. DEKODE recommended their AttendMe App to replace our paper based method of maintaining visitors log, late arrival and early departure of students, teachers attendance and sick bay. They were very responsive to our specific needs in a very tight time frame. Excellent follow up service has allowed us to have a useful and stable tool for use in the school environment.
testimonials.author: Leon Colla
testimonials.role: Principal, St Mary of the Cross Catholic School

testimonials.quote: We asked DEKODE to develop a product for us, a product where we could have our staff log in and out, our visitors log in and out and for our parents to enter in Late Arrivals or Early Dismissals. That was it, no further information was given. DEKODE provided us within a matter of a week a platform that was exactly what we had asked for. The completed product was then delivered in full within 3 weeks. The follow up customer service after installation is quality, I would highly recommend DEKODE to any other business with which we have already done.
testimonials.author: Kirsty Palimaka
testimonials.role: Admin, St Mary of the Cross Catholic Primary School

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: At DEKODE, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data.

sections.summary: We may collect the following types of information when you interact with our services: Contact Information: Name, email address, phone number, and company details provided through forms or direct communication. Usage Data: Information about how you interact with our website, including IP addresses, browser types, and pages visited, collected via analytics tools. Project Data: Information relevant to the execution and delivery of consulting and development services.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.summary: We use the collected information for the following purposes: To provide, operate, and maintain our services. To communicate with you, including responding to inquiries and providing project updates. To improve our website and services through analyzing user behavior. To comply with legal obligations and enforce our terms.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.summary: As a technology consultancy focused on secure foundations, we take data security seriously. We implement robust, industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. We emphasize "Security-first" principles in all our operations.

sections.title: Sharing Your Information
sections.summary: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal identification information to others. We may share generic aggregated demographic information not linked to any personal identification information with our business partners. We may use third-party service providers to help us operate our business, provided they adhere to strict confidentiality agreements.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.summary: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. If you wish to exercise these rights or have any questions about our privacy practices, please contact us using the details above.
